method: First/middle/last affordable absent-Barracks states. Preserve every original option and add conditional producer-then-one-unit plans for all absent producers with an immediate purchase and previously observed Train controls/catalog. Historical facts accumulated only through each sample. Same state, alternate baseline/chain order, six calls maximum. No plan execution; selection and feasibility are separate questions.
limitations: Three recorded recovery states from one losing run; no causal gameplay evidence.
Reported winners are model top choices; live investment policy samples Jev probabilities.
Adding plans changes menu cardinality and probability distribution. Chain probability mass is not a calibrated benefit or a reason to force a producer purchase.
Historical training controls do not establish current prerequisites. No plan was executed.
